summary: Verified 3-dimensional permission system implementation. All features working correctly: Users & Permissions page loads at /admin/users-permissions, user rows open side panel with 3D permissions UI, CRUD checkboxes work, Data Visibility Scope dropdown has all 4 options, Others' Data Permissions checkboxes work, Save Permissions button saves module_permissions to backend successfully.

features_verified: 1. Users & Permissions page loads correctly at /admin/users-permissions ✓
2. Clicking on a user row opens the User Permissions side panel ✓
3. Module Access section shows CRUD checkboxes (Create, Read, Update, Delete) ✓
4. Data Visibility Scope dropdown shows 4 options: All Data, Team/Department, Own+Assigned, Own Only ✓
5. Others' Data Permissions section shows 'Can Edit Others' Data' and 'Can Delete Others' Data' checkboxes ✓
6. Expanding a module shows sub-modules list ✓
7. Permission Guide shows explanatory text at the bottom ✓
8. Save Permissions button saves the module_permissions to backend ✓
9. Backend /api/system-modules/user/{id}/access accepts module_permissions in PUT request ✓

dimension_1_crud.create: Checkbox to allow/deny creating new records

dimension_2_data_ownership.can_edit_others: Allow editing records created by other users
dimension_2_data_ownership.can_delete_others: Allow deleting records created by other users

context_for_next_testing_agent: 3-dimensional permission system is fully implemented and working. Backend stores module_permissions in user document with CRUD flags, data_scope, can_edit_others, and can_delete_others. Frontend UI in UsersPermissionsPage.jsx shows all 3 dimensions in expandable module cards. Permission utility functions in /app/backend/utils/permissions.py provide get_data_scope_query, can_user_crud, and can_user_modify_others_data for enforcing permissions.
